Hi Jasmine — thanks for the detailed list and for the attachments. Quick answers and next steps below. I copied Procurement and Sales Ops to make sure nothing slips through the cracks.

1) ACH vs Wire: We accept both ACH and wire. ACH is our default for domestic US vendors — faster reconciliation and no intermediary fees on our side. Wires are accepted for urgent payments or international vendors; please note wires may take 1–3 business days and sometimes incur bank fees. If you expect to only take wires, let us know and we'll flag it with AP.

2) Remittance: Please set remittance emails to ap-invoices@redwood.ai. We require remittance emails to include the invoice number and Redwood PO (if applicable) in the subject line.

3) PO requirement: Redwood issues POs for engagements with committed spend > $5,000. For smaller one-off invoices we can process without a PO, but a PO number is required for invoiced milestones tied to an open contract. POs are generated by Procurement; turnaround is typically 1–2 business days after the quote is approved.

4) Secure transmission of banking/tax docs: We prefer bank authorizations and W-9s via our secure vendor portal (link below) or DocuSign for bank authorization forms — we don't accept unencrypted bank details over regular email. Please use the DocuSign link Lauren shared in the follow-up.

5) Payment terms: Standard terms are Net30 from invoice receipt unless otherwise negotiated. We can discuss Net45 or early-pay terms if your team needs different timing — note that extended terms may delay the first payment cycle.

Next steps: Lauren, could you confirm the DocuSign and portal links and add any missing items on the Redwood vendor checklist? Jasmine — once you confirm you'll submit bank details via the secure portal we will kick off vendor setup and confirm the expected first payment date.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Jasmine — welcome, and thanks for sending the vendor form and W-9. A couple of procurement-specific clarifications and the checklist we use to complete vendor setups: 

Checklist (high level):
- Signed vendor onboarding form (received)
- W-9 or appropriate tax form (received)
- Bank account verification via secure portal or completed ACH Authorization form (DocuSign link below)
- Vendor contact for remittance (email + person)
- Copy of sample invoice (PDF) showing invoice number, line items, total, and remittance info
- Entity verification docs for payments > $50k (if applicable)
- Confirm currency and tax registration (US vendors must provide TIN)

DocuSign bank authorization link (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/redirect?token=EXAMPLE
Our accounting inbox for invoices and remittance: ap-invoices@redwood.ai

Additional notes:
- Invoices must include Redwood's PO number when a PO exists; place it in the invoice header. If you submit without a PO for an invoice that requires one, processing will be delayed until the PO is attached.
- For payments processed through a third-party (APV Payments), please ensure the remittance email includes the actual beneficiary name and bank reference so our AP team can reconcile.
- For international wires, include SWIFT/BIC and intermediary bank details on the invoice or as a secure attachment.

If you prefer, we can run a short walkthrough of the vendor portal this week. I have availability tomorrow at 2pm PT or Wednesday morning.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
